name: memauthority
description: Git-backed long-term memory authority for AI agents.
long_description: MemAuthority gives AI agents durable, Git-backed project memory with validated writes, revision safety, and explicit current Authority. This MCP Bundle runs the local stdio server against a Vault directory selected by the user.

vault_directory.title: MemAuthority Vault
vault_directory.description: Select the Git-backed Vault directory that stores MemAuthority Authority.

state_directory.title: Runtime state directory
state_directory.description: Select a runtime-private state directory outside the Vault Authority directory.

write_enabled.title: Enable memory writes
write_enabled.description: Allow MemAuthority mutation tools to update the selected Vault. Leave off for read-only use.
